name: stress-ng cache
description: Start N workers that perform random wide spread memory read and writes to thrash the CPU cache. The code does not intelligently determine the CPU cache configuration and so it may be sub-optimal in producing hit-miss read/write activity for some processors. Note: to exercise cache misses it is recommended to instead use the matrix-3d stressor using the --matrix-3d-zyx option. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
